component: S/MIME verification callback and completion contract

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The verifier receives an object with a verifyCertFinished method whose function is the promise resolver. The command awaits the returned status value and branches on0 versus a failure code. Certificate verification failure is therefore represented by that status, not by deliberately rejecting the bridge promise. A short adjacent comment explains the callback-object shape, which is less obvious than the minimal object syntax. This is the scoped callback contract in the checked S/MIME helper; it does not guarantee every synchronous API exception is caught or every callback eventually fires. No runtime verifier test ran.
title: The S/MIME callback bridge resolves with a verification status value
